title: UniWALM: Unified World Action Language Model for Embodied Robot Control
title_zh: UniWALM：面向具身机器人控制的统一世界-动作-语言模型

paragraphs.en: 总结：UniWALM将视频、动作与语言统一于单一共享表征，通过语言即记忆闭环与轨迹纠错训练，显著提升具身机器人操控与记忆相关任务表现。 Motivated by the human ability to integrate experience across language, perception, and action, we introduce UniWALM, a unified world-action-language model that learns video, action, and language in a single shared representation, where each modality is both a conditioning signal and a supervision target. We ask: can jointly generating language enrich this shared representation, improving manipulation and supporting memory-dependent behavior? Unlike prior approaches that attach a reasoning or vision-language model to a video-action backbone and run them as distinct stages, UniWALM unifies all three modalities inside a single mixture-of-transformers backbone whose per-modality diffusion heads co-denoise synchronously, decoding subtask and textual memory in the same pass as action with no separate planning stage; the generated language is re-consumed on the next step, closing a language-as-memory loop without an external planner or memory bank. To keep the action stream reliable under this richer objective, we further introduce Flow Matching with Correction (FMC), a training objective that teaches recovery from perturbed action trajectories at no inference-time cost. UniWALM consistently improves over same-backbone baselines (e.g., FastWAM) on compositional pick-and-place (MolmoSpaces) and across the memory-dependent subset of RMBench, where it reaches 34.5% without any pretrained language or reasoning model and exceeds Mem-0's keyframe-equipped setup (28.5%) using only a single anchor frame. On a real-world Find-the-Item task, generating textual memory lifts success from 11.1% to 61.1%, while state-of-the-art VLAs stay at or below chance (<=33.3%).
paragraphs.zh: 总结：UniWALM将视频、动作与语言统一于单一共享表征，通过语言即记忆闭环与轨迹纠错训练，显著提升具身机器人操控与记忆相关任务表现。 受人类能够跨语言、感知与动作整合经验的能力启发，我们提出了UniWALM，一个统一的世界-动作-语言模型，它在单一共享表征中学习视频、动作与语言，其中每种模态既是条件信号，也是监督目标。 我们提出这样的问题：联合生成语言能否丰富这一共享表征，从而提升操控能力并支持依赖记忆的行为？ 与以往将推理模型或视觉-语言模型附加到视频-动作主干上、并作为不同阶段运行的方法不同，UniWALM将三种模态统一在单一的混合Transformer主干中，其各模态的扩散头同步协同去噪，在与动作相同的传递中解码子任务与文本记忆，无需独立的规划阶段；生成的语言在下一步被重新消费，形成语言即记忆的闭环，而无需外部规划器或记忆库。 为了在这一更丰富的目标下保持动作流的可靠性，我们进一步提出了带纠错的流匹配（FMC），这是一种训练目标，能够教会模型从受扰动的动作轨迹中恢复，且不产生任何推理时的额外开销。 UniWALM在同主干基线（如FastWAM）之上，在组合式抓取与放置任务（MolmoSpaces）以及RMBench中依赖记忆的子集上持续取得提升；在该子集上，它在没有任何预训练语言或推理模型的情况下达到34.5%，并且仅使用单个锚定帧就超过了Mem-0配备关键帧的设置（28.5%）。 在真实世界的寻找物品任务中，生成文本记忆将成功率从11.1%提升到61.1%，而最先进的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）则停留在随机水平或以下（≤33.3%）。
